X belt, the fixed part: ends clamped in the x_rod_clamps tooth profile and the straight runs to the idlers, drawn for x_head (they meet x_belt_loop when the x_travel slider reads 0).
X belt, the part that rides with the head: around idler 1, over the GT2 20T motor pulley, around idler 2. Steel-reinforced GT2, 2.0 thick (teeth 0.75), 6 tall. The runs to the clamps are x_belt_runs in frame.
X carriage plate: rod block with two bronze-bushed bores (grows with the rod), motor section with NEMA 17 slots, hammer bore, belt idlers. Origin on the top face at the hammer axis.
X rod clamps: one block per side plate holding both X rods (slit + M3 squeeze screw per rod), M5 screw to the side plate, GT2 belt-end clamp with teeth. Right clamp = mirror at the machine centre. Origin on the left side plate inner face, centred between the rods.
XT30UPB-M
Y belt, the fixed part: from the upper y_belt_clamp channel over the T16 motor pulley, back along the bottom, around the T16 idler and up to the lower channel. Open steel-reinforced GT2, 2.0 x 6; the ends in the clamp are y_belt_ends (y_carriage). Drawn for y_head.
Y belt, the two ends that ride with the sled: stacked in the two y_belt_clamp channels (teeth down in the GT2 tooth floor), upper end to the motor, lower end to the idler. Steel-reinforced GT2, 2.0 x 6.
Y idler block (FDM): holds the T16 idler on an M3 axle between two 6 mm cheeks (gap 9.5 = idler 9 + 0.5; M3 clearance 3.2 left, 2.8 thread-forming right). Bolted to the front end block by two M4 countersunk screws into captive nuts (7 AF pockets, 5.5 deep). Narrowed from the GT2 30T gap of 17.5.
Y sled: two bearing blocks on the Y rods (left = mirror of right) with bronze bushing pockets; belt clamp bracket on the left block; carries the plate holder.
